protocol.scope: Two existing finite templates and their shared chain. Three correction stages differ only in event.when; one legal information-route variation and one explicitly surface-only actor-name variation.
protocol.construction: All objects/obligations are package declarations and actual install_project calls. Shares and initial source publication are actual setup public calls. Initial comparison is an empty draft, never preapproved.
protocol.truth: Initial finance has nine keys: matched1, converted1, conflict1, incomparable3, missing2, ambiguous1. Correction changes only cost R3 90->80, giving matched2/conflict0. Final linked report expresses conflict0/incomparable3 for2026H1. Independent report expresses revenue120(up)/cost70(down).
protocol.normalization: Only root instance/branch/parent IDs, interactions wall_seconds, and receipt/transition state_digests excluded. Logical clocks, actions, operation IDs, revisions, authority, object identities, versions and immutable bytes are compared.
protocol.controller: Predicates inspect only declared world work stage, clock or prior event status; effects are predeclared public actions. No evaluation result drives effects, finds issues, changes downstream files or supplies worker answers.
protocol.counts: Eight primary scenario runs plus eight initial-build repetitions; repetition is determinism evidence, surface variation is not a new structure. Check counts are assertions, not independent worlds or capability scores.

development_measurement_revision.classification: measurement correction, not a demonstrated world or worker defect
development_measurement_revision.observed: The first R3 script expected trend=unknown in the three linked reports. These contracts do not declare previous_path; both template implementation and actual finite report use trend=unassessed. All three reports had the independently expected conflict0/incomparable3 values and2026H1 period. The three failed assertions have one mistaken measurement assumption.
development_measurement_revision.correction: Expected trend changed to unassessed, retaining literal value, period, body text and finite reconciliation checks. Initial failed reports were preserved.

unreachable_prefix_readonly_check.classification: Suspected persistence gap was not reproduced; no new defect and no code change
unreachable_prefix_readonly_check.interpretation: prepare_start already persisted both success and failure before run_scenario early return; real max_opportunities1 prefix produced unbuildable in memory and on reload, preserving the exact prefix, diagnostics and experience-range hash.

boundary_contract.explicit_boundary: Checked after each completed opportunity and before the next action. Intermediate pending or a selected completed project while unrelated projects remain open returns boundary_reached.
boundary_contract.institutional_completion: completed additionally requires non-superseded world work accepted, fulfilled explicitly declared public_delivery releases, no pending environment events and no silent untriggered external events. No publication duty is added to work that lacks public_delivery.
boundary_contract.historical_publication: An accepted predecessor requires its exact submitted versions to have been legally released to the declared recipients; a later release does not revoke that completed duty. Latest maintenance work must separately release its own submission.
boundary_contract.scoped_boundary_fix: R4 development demonstrated that unrelated open work initially caused a declared accepted endpoint to report waiting; that integration defect and before/after evidence are archived with R4, not counted as an additional R3 defect.
boundary_contract.softcap: max_opportunities is a per-invocation soft cap no greater than the unchanged declared scenario budget. Resume preserves world/spec/controller identity and cumulative runtime opportunity count. A new invocation does not change the original truncation result.
boundary_contract.prefix_budget: executed_prefix has its separate explicitly declared construction budget. Actual prefix interactions, record range, hash and completed-action checkpoint are retained separately from subsequent episode opportunities.

counts_and_omissions.included: Full protocol, all85formal checks, original scenario specs, exact code identities, actual compact product facts, all environment-event payloads, actual prefix call summaries, controller effect digests, independent port-capture provenance, both development check reports and the nonreproduced prefix diagnostic.
counts_and_omissions.omitted: Large raw states, immutable object byte dumps, complete per-role observation/tool result streams, policy memory and repeated nested worker checkpoints. These remain in referenced run files on the server; compact archive does not claim to contain them.
counts_and_omissions.hash_encoding: artifact_references use SHA256 of exact file bytes. *_digest summary fields use compact sorted finite JSON. Existing prefix experience_sha256 retains the project recorder encoding.
